Barbarian_Legendary_002.name: Hemorrhage
Barbarian_Legendary_002.desc: Applying a Damage Over Time effect to a Vulnerable enemy deals 75%\[x\] increased damage.

Barbarian_Legendary_004.name: Blood Rage
Barbarian_Legendary_004.desc: Killing an enemy affected by a Damage Over Time effect has 10% chance to grant Berserking for 5 seconds. Your damage is increased by 60%\[x\] while Berserking.

Barbarian_Legendary_009.name: Carnage
Barbarian_Legendary_009.desc: Berserking now additionally grants 15%\[+\] Attack Speed. You deal 45%\[x\] increased Fire and Physical damage.

Barbarian_Legendary_014.name: Decimator
Barbarian_Legendary_014.desc: You deal 25%\[x\] increased damage to Vulnerable enemies. You deal 25%\[x\] increased damage while you have Overpower charges.

Barbarian_Legendary_015.name: Bone Breaker
Barbarian_Legendary_015.desc: Every 12 seconds, gain a charge of Overpower. Whenever you attack while having an Overpower charge, your Ultimate Skills deal 10%\[x\] increased damage for 10 seconds, up to 80%\[x\].

Barbarian_Legendary_016.name: Flawless Technique
Barbarian_Legendary_016.desc: Consecutive attacking with the same weapon increases your Critical Strike chance by 5%\[+\] and Critical Strike Damage by 50%\[x\] for 4 seconds.

Barbarian_Legendary_011.name: Warbringer
Barbarian_Legendary_011.desc: For every 300 Fury you spend, gain 2% of your Maximum Life ([0.02*PlayerHealthMax()||]) as Fortify. Deal 45%\[x\] increased damage while Fortified.

Barbarian_Legendary_017.name: Weapons Master
Barbarian_Legendary_017.desc: Swapping weapons grants you 4 Fury. You deal 75%\[x\] increased damage to Injured and Healthy enemies.

Barbarian_Legendary_001.name: Force of Nature
Barbarian_Legendary_001.desc: Skills that cast Earthquakes and Dust Devils deal 45%\[x\] increased damage.
